cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: The Handoff Already Happened
cards.instruction: Get them to accept responsibility by returning to earlier offers until the task seems to have been assigned all along.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. You said you'd take it from here. Here are the unanswered wedding invitations.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I meant I'd answer the door.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. Exactly. These people need an answer before reaching it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then help me explain where your generous offer ended.

mechanism: Copy an address label as postage, then turn B's earlier offer to demonstrate posting into an already assigned mailing job.
confusable: Not simply delegating an unpleasant task: the misunderstood labels must create the technical dependency A folds back into B's earlier offer.
comparison: Wedding envelopes and a post-office appointment differ from a fete banner and a missing raffle time.
seedUse: Retains invitations and expansion of an earlier help offer; replaces door wordplay with copied mailing preparation.
